The '''Whendyll system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Cademimu sector/Legends|Cademimu sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and consisting of seven [[Planet/Legends|planets]] including [[Port Haven/Legends|Port Haven]].
